Sofia, it was **Pellow** (Pellow Home Living, the retail account). The Feb 17 #coastal-team thread has you and Kwame confirming it: the door 6 lamp delivery sat on the retail account, and the Gulf Coast terminal rows were Pellucid Harbor Logistics. The "PHL" acronym collided after the rename, which is probably what caused the February mix-up.

Source: #coastal-team, 2026-02-17 (09:12–09:18)
